lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs L d _ => exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs L d).wf.2.1)
  case tabs L d _ => exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs L d).wf.2.1)
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl with
    | inl vl =>
      cases ih_r rfl with
      | inl vr =>
        obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      | inr hr =>
        obtain ⟨_, hr⟩ := hr
        exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl hr⟩
    | inr hl =>
      obtain ⟨_, hl⟩ := hl
      exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 hl⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    right
    have lc := (Sub.wf _ _ _ s).2.1.lc
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc lc⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .tapp lc h⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d db ih _ =>
    right
    have body : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact ⟨_, .let_body v body⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .let_bind h body⟩
  case inl d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact .inl (.inl v)
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact .inr ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact .inl (.inr v)
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact .inr ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L d db₂ db₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have b₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    have b₃ : t₃.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · subst t₁
        cases v with | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v b₂ b₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases v with | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v b₂ b₃⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; exact lc
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case app l r il ir =>
    rcases il rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨_, hl⟩
    · rcases ir rfl r.wf.2.1 with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact .inr ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨_, .appᵣ vl hr⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 hl⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    have ty := (Sub.wf _ _ _ s).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact .inr ⟨_, .tabs v.lc ty⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .tapp ty h⟩
  case let' d _ ih _ =>
    have body := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .let_body v body⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .let_bind h body⟩
  case inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · left; constructor; exact v
    · exact .inr ⟨_, by constructor; exact h⟩
  case case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;>
        cases v <;> first
        | exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inl ‹_› b₂ b₃⟩
        | exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inr ‹_› b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; exact lc
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r il ir =>
    have := r.wf.2.1
    rcases il rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨_, hl⟩
    case' inl => rcases ir rfl r.wf.2.1 with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
      case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
  case' tapp d s ih =>
    have := (Sub.wf _ _ _ s).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' let' d _ ih _ =>
    have := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
